content:
Great job getting into Warrior One pose! Let’s refine your alignment a little to help you get the most benefit from the posture.

First, I’ve noticed that your **spine is not straight**. Try to gently draw your tailbone down and lengthen through the crown of your head, so your torso stacks directly over your hips. Imagine a long, straight line from the base of your spine to the top of your head.

Next, your **arms are not reaching straight up**. Bring your arms parallel to each other, reaching them up toward the ceiling. Keep your shoulders relaxed and actively extend through your fingertips so your arms are energized and aligned overhead.

Finally, your **knee is not directly over your ankle** on the front leg. Please check in and ensure that your front knee stacks right above the ankle. You may need to adjust the distance between your feet to find stability and proper alignment here.

You’re making great progress—these small adjustments will help strengthen your foundation and deepen your practice. Keep going, and let me know how it feels!
